Apple Pay is an essential feature for iPhone users when shopping at physical stores, online shops and apps. Apple recently announced four new features that make Apple Pay even more useful. Here's how these features work, along with a major expansion currently rolling out.

iOS 27 新設計

One of my favourite changes in iOS 27 is the redesigned Apple Pay checkout interface. The new interface makes it easier to switch between different cards during the checkout process on websites and apps.

In the new design, you can easily swipe to switch between different cards on the main Apple Pay checkout screen. You can also tap on any card to view all available Apple Pay cards in a grid format.

The new design also lets you see more detailed information for each card, including rewards, balances, instalment options and more.

iOS 27 is now available to developers and public beta users, and will officially launch this autumn.

美國運通獎賞

Apple and American Express previously announced a new partnership that allows payments using American Express reward points.

When you use an American Express card to shop online or in apps, you'll see a new "Use Rewards" option in the checkout flow, displayed along with your Membership Rewards points balance. You can use points to pay for the transaction in full or in part.

American Express points redeemed through Apple Pay are worth 0.7 US cents each. For example, 10,000 points can be exchanged for US$70 to pay for your order.

一拍即傳

In iOS 27, Apple has added a new "Tap to Connect" feature that integrates with Apple Pay on iPhone for use in physical store shopping.

Apple says this feature, launching this autumn, is an extension of the "Tap to Pay" feature on iPhone. Here's Apple's explanation:

With a simple tap, customers can connect with a participating merchant's iPhone for a more personalised and quicker in-store shopping experience, securely sharing email, other contact details, shipping addresses, membership reward information and more. Customers can also see items in their shopping basket in real time, track what they've bought, and ensure all discounts and offers are applied correctly.

When finished, customers can complete checkout using Apple Pay on their own iPhone.

為扣帳卡增值

Later this year, iPhone users will be able to manage their debit card balances directly within the Apple Pay interface.

According to Apple, you can top up supported debit cards through Apple Pay, either directly in Apple Wallet or at checkout.

額外消息：Apple Pay 登陸 Walmart

This isn't a new feature developed by Apple itself, but something that should have happened long ago and has finally come true. Walmart has announced it has finally started supporting Apple Pay. Apple Pay will also land at Sam's Club as part of this initiative.

Walmart has already begun rolling out Apple Pay (along with broader contactless payment support) in Arkansas this week. The retailer says it will be available at stores across the US before the end of this year.

總結

With Apple Pay becoming increasingly widespread and popular among retailers, it's great to see Apple continuing to improve the experience. For me, whether shopping online or in physical stores, Apple Pay is basically my go-to payment method at checkout.

How often do you use Apple Pay? What's your favourite Apple Pay feature? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
